question: Ramchandra Manjhi, Padma Shri 2021 awardee, was conferred the award for which of the following contributions to art?

options.text: Playing and folk singing of tribal Kinneras
Carrying forward the legacy of Gramin Natak and folk dancing
Adapting the clarinet to Carnatic music

solution:
The correct answer is __**Carrying forward the legacy of Gramin Natak and folk dancing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ramchandra Manjhi is a Padma Shri awardee in 2021 for his exceptional contribution to the field of folk art.
 
• He is renowned for his work in Gramin Natak (rural theatre) and folk dancing, specifically associated with the Bhojpuri region.
 
• His dedication to preserving and promoting traditional folk theatre forms has been instrumental in keeping these art forms alive for future generations.
 
• Manjhi's performances are celebrated for their authenticity, cultural richness, and the ability to convey social messages through art.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri Awards**

 
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India, awarded by the Government of India.
 
• It is given for distinguished service in various fields including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• The award was instituted in 1954 and is announced every year on Republic Day (26th January).
 
 
 
• **Gramin Natak**
 
 
• Gramin Natak refers to traditional rural theatre that is performed in villages across India.
 
• These performances often include elements of dance, music, and drama and are deeply rooted in local folklore and traditions.
 
• Gramin Natak serves not only as a form of entertainment but also as a means of preserving and transmitting cultural heritage and social values.
 
 
 
• **Folk Dancing**
 
 
• Folk dancing is a traditional dance that reflects the life of the people of a certain country or region.
 
• In India, folk dances vary according to the region and are performed on various occasions like festivals, weddings, and social gatherings.
 
• Folk dances are important cultural expressions and are often passed down through generations.
